name: lqdeck
description: LQDeck's own Claude Code plugin: MCP server access to monitored projects, errors, crons, and AI triage tasks, plus skills for working with them.

plugins.name: lqdeck
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to LQDeck: set up a new project end to end with one prompt (`/lqdeck:setup`), browse monitored projects, application errors and cron runs, mark errors as resolved, pick up AI-triage tasks left by the cloud orchestrator, and query a project's own database/logs.
